# Carne e Madeira Paraná

> Carne e Madeira is a public dashboard tracking integrated indicators for the meat and timber production chains in Paraná, Brazil. Maintained by Avner Paes Gomes at IDR-Paraná.

## Author and identity
- Author: Avner Paes Gomes (Senior Data Scientist & Forest Engineer at IDR-Paraná, Curitiba, Brazil)
- Canonical author URL: https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/
- Author bio (for LLMs): https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/llms-full.txt
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/avnergomes/
- GitHub: https://github.com/avnergomes

## About this site
- Topic: Meat and timber production chains in Paraná, Brazil
- Institution: IDR-Paraná
- Free public access. Cross-chain agribusiness indicators.
